stem.alt: Two battery symbols in series, each in a dashed box: battery 1 with 12 V and a 0.3 Ω internal resistor, and battery 2 with 9 V and a 0.1 Ω internal resistor.

stem.text: Battery 1 has electromotive force (e.m.f.) $12\,\text{V}$ and internal resistance $0.3\,\Omega$.
Battery 2 has e.m.f. $9\,\text{V}$ and internal resistance $0.1\,\Omega$.
What are the e.m.f. and the internal resistance of a single battery that has the same effect as the combination?
